correctness.rationale: The hyperelliptic quotient reduces rational order-three symmetry to translation, and the invariant-ring normal form gives the eight models. A finite exhaustive checker covers 2186 nonzero binary sextics, 1296 geometrically squarefree equations, 24 projective transformations, 69 arithmetic orbits, point counts over F3 and F9, 50 Weil types and the eight singleton fibers; a second fixed-form enumeration returns 42 invariant sextics. All identities use exact F3/F9 arithmetic, not extrapolated sampling.

value.rationale: A Weil polynomial determines only the Jacobian isogeny class in general and does not normally isolate a genus-two curve. The exact eight singleton Weil types give an arithmetic-Torelli rigidity phenomenon and characterize the rational wild order-three symmetry intrinsically. Among 69 arithmetic classes there are only 50 Weil types, making the eight singleton fibers a non-automatic, natural arithmetic invariant, rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
